comment: The coverage gate (test-strategy.md §6). The v0.2.0 release target
is 100% statement coverage of non-generated Go, enforced as ZERO
uncovered eligible statements - not a rounded 100.0% display - across
BOTH Go modules, each measured and reported separately:
- the root product module (measured with -coverpkg=./... so a
statement executed as a dependency of another package's test is
- the nested tools/requirements module (its own go.mod; a root
max_uncovered is the ceiling on eligible uncovered statement blocks
per module; 0 is the release requirement. exclusions live in
coverage-exclusions.txt, one path prefix per line with a reason,
reviewed like ACs - there are none.
